name: local conditional temporal surrogate
motivating_evidence: Attempt1 zero gain versus joint-support control; reference constant within video-duration and only14 of4991 top1 changed.
hypothesis: Local excess conjunction beyond phase-shifted residuals, conditional on holistic query evidence, supplies additional useful ranking evidence.
formula: z=standardized predicate traces; h=standardized holistic trace; fitted_p=(z_p dot h)/(h dot h+eps)*h; r_p=z_p-fitted_p; delta(I)=mean_I[C(z)-mean_b C(fitted+independent_roll(r,b))].
controls: whole-query inside/outside contrast (established OIC; not claimed new)
shared-slope linear recalibration with video-specific residual reference
selection: previous strongest-control coefficients frozen; one nonnegative residual weight per variant on dev_select only
success: atleast.25pp R1@.5 gain and positive paired95CI against strongest select-chosen control on dev_confirm
limitations: conditional regression is an established statistical technique; exact mechanism novelty unproven
conditioning on full-query similarity may remove true relevant association
confirmation reused adaptively; eventual finalval required
